taskDescription:
make a way to save data in a local file in the project dir. I think the project dir will be saved in the brain.

but ideally, all ai data will be saved in a .csv file with headers

agent | skill | avg runtime | avg tokens | runs 

since we count the runs, we can calculate the averages too. this should be used as a running total to see if updates help the system. I want to keep this file permanently. 

try to do this deterministically where the agent calls a script in the hook which saves this data .

how would you do this? shoe me the plan when it's ready
